resolution.rejection_description: Rejected because the de-duplication candidate set contained whitelisted records while the applicant carried no whitelisting. Only a whitelisted applicant may be processed against whitelisted candidates.
resolution.synthesis: The resident applied for a fresh enrolment and matched records that carry a whitelist marking, which exempts a known group of records from the normal duplicate treatment. Because the applicant held no whitelisting of their own, the packet could not be processed alongside those records and was rejected. The applicant must be whitelisted so the packet can be reprocessed against the same candidate set.
